trigger: Enter the Prater Way pharmacy at dusk (for Lolo's clinic supplies).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The pharmacy door is a frame of broken glass. Inside, a flashlight beam flicks off.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Freezes. Low growl. Points at the back room.]

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Okay. Okay okay. Call off the wolf. I'm not armed. I mean I am. But not at you.

choices.text: Come out where I can see you.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Stops. Still watching. Tail low.]

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Wow. Cool. Very effective. I am extremely cooperative now.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A girl, maybe nineteen. Hoodie, ski goggles on her head, a duffel of pill bottles.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Kit. Hi. Shelves are mostly picked. I got the back room. Antibiotics, gauze, blood pressure stuff.

choices.text: I need clinic supplies. For a nurse.
Who are you selling this to?

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: A nurse? Real one? ...Fine. Take the gauze and the amoxicillin. I'm not a monster.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: The rest goes to the Viaduct. People there are sick too, Wrench. Nobody's bringing them a nurse.

choices.text: [Take what she offers. Let her go]

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Whoever's got food. Mostly the guys under the viaduct. They had warehouse jobs on Monday.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Or what? You'll shoot a girl in a CVS for Lipitor? Come on.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You pull the duffel off her shoulder. She doesn't fight. She just looks at you, memorizing.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Cool. Cool. You're one of those. I'll remember the dog.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You write: TOOK GAUZE, AMOXICILLIN FOR CLINIC ON 9TH. B. PEARCE. You tape it to the register.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: ...You left a NOTE? Who's gonna read it? Oh my god. You're adorable. Bye, Wrench.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Pleasure doing crime with you. If anyone asks, I was never here. Neither was the wolf.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Outside, a flashlight. Deputy Lusk and two men from the block watch, rifles low.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Pearce. What's in the bag?

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Pearce. That's a big bag. What's in the big bag?

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: ...Lolo. Fine. Tell her my mom's pills ran out. She knows which.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lusk takes the bag. 'Evidence.' You both know it isn't.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A rifle comes up. Wraith steps in front of you. Somebody says, 'Whoa, whoa.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Head home before full dark. Carly should be awake.
